primaryEncounterLead: '''Artio''' is a weaker variant of [[Callisto]] who is fought in the [[Hunter's End]], a [[singles-plus combat]] area in level 21 [[Wilderness]]. To enter Artio's lair, players must have completed the [[Wilderness Diary#Hard|hard Wilderness diary]], '''OR''' they must have a Callisto boss Slayer task (a bear Slayer task does not bypass the diary requirement).

'''Callisto''' is an enormous bear empowered by the corruption of the [[Wilderness]] that resides in [[Callisto's Den]] at level 40 [[Wilderness]] and is the one of two monsters to drop the [[tyrannical ring]].

'''Vet'ion''' (pronounced {{IPAc-en|'|v|E|t|i:|@|n}} {{respell|VET|ee|ən}}) is a Zamorakian{{CiteNPC|npc=Andros Mai|quote=Vet'ion was a devout follower of the heretical god Zamorak.|loc=|notes=|name=}} [[Skeleton|skeletal]] champion that resides in [[Vet'ion's Rest]], at level 35 [[Wilderness]]. Like other bosses in the Wilderness, he can also drop the [[dragon pickaxe]].
'''Venenatis''' is a large spider that resides in the [[Silk Chasm]], at level 35 [[Wilderness]].
